ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels covering >90% of the visible surface area, with sparse, high-intensity (white) linear and punctate pixel disruptions providing a high local contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black/dark-grey field across the entire fluke surface. High-contrast white markings are non-contiguous, appearing as disorganized linear segments and small circular points localized primarily in the central and lower-left regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 50-60 degrees, bisecting the two fluke lobes at the vertical centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Visible pixel-amplitude variations indicate a sequence of sharp peaks and shallow, rounded valleys, with one prominent deep indentation on the inner-left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges transitioning to sharp, upward-curving distal tips. The leading edge (partially visible) suggests a convex trajectory toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular, raised pixel groups localized at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting calcified colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths, most densely concentrated on the lower-left and central-inner portions of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the left lobe; dense textured clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of three distinct, parallel vertical white scratches located just to the left of the median notch.
